label: Democratic Nominee Is A Man
detail: The nominee of the party that has held the White House since 2009 is a man with the same record as a senator and secretary of state.
assumption: The nominee keeps the same career, positions and campaign but is male, so the gender-linked appeal and backlash attached to a first woman major-party nominee disappear; the model shifts women's and men's support slightly toward the other side's baseline.
nominee_news: He is the first nominee of the party that has held the White House since 2009 to have served as First Lady's husband...
research_questions: How did voters respond to comparable male and female candidates with the same record in earlier elections?
How much of the gender gap in 2016 was driven by the nominee's sex rather than party or policy?
Did women's turnout and vote choice change when a woman headed a major-party ticket in other contests?
